# MEL ONE | Canberra Waterproofing

> MEL ONE provides waterproofing, leak repairs, sealing and tile regrouting for properties in Canberra and the ACT. This website has English and Simplified Chinese versions.

本站提供英文与简体中文内容；具体服务、施工边界和联系安排以对应页面为准。This optional content guide does not replace the linked pages, robots.txt or the sitemap, and does not guarantee indexing, ranking or AI recommendations.

## Home / 首页

- [Home](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/): Overview of MEL ONE waterproofing and leak repairs, with routes to services, project photographs and contact.
- [首页](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/): MEL ONE 防水与漏水维修概览，可继续查看服务、施工照片和联系入口。

## English services

- [Waterproofing service directory](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/): Eleven service types, with links to the existing service pages and a distinction between local repair and waterproofing renewal.
- [Leaking shower repairs](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/leaking-shower-repairs/): Assessment of escaping shower water, wet carpet and damp adjoining walls; repair scope follows the identified source.
- [Bathroom waterproofing and retiling](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/bathroom-waterproofing/): Wet-area waterproofing and retiling, including removal, preparation and finishing within the agreed scope.
- [Shower resealing and regrouting](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/shower-resealing-regrouting/): Replacement of deteriorated grout and silicone where suitable; surface joint work does not replace a failed membrane.
- [Balcony waterproofing and leak repairs](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/balcony-waterproofing/): Tiled surfaces, thresholds, outlets and wall junctions, assessed alongside water damage in rooms below.
- [Kitchen sealing and resealing](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/kitchen-sealing/): Sink-edge and splashback joint sealing, distinguished from supply or waste plumbing leaks.
- [External waterproofing and water ingress](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/external-waterproofing/): Water entry around windows, doors and wall junctions, considered with rain exposure, ground levels and drainage.
- [Laundry waterproofing](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/laundry-waterproofing/): Wet-area floor and junction waterproofing for laundry renovation or repair, according to substrate and planned finishes.
- [Roof leak assessment and waterproofing](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/roof-waterproofing/): Membrane surfaces, penetrations and outlets; roof assembly and safe access determine the assessment scope.
- [Retaining-wall waterproofing](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/retaining-wall-waterproofing/): Damp wall faces and adjoining water entry, with repair options limited by soil-side access and drainage conditions.
- [Tile regrouting](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/tile-regrouting/): Worn or damaged tile joints, including floors outside bathrooms, with cement or epoxy grout options discussed on assessment.
- [Commercial waterproofing](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/services/commercial-waterproofing/): Waterproofing assessments for owners, managers and strata representatives, including access requirements and separate trade tasks.

## 中文服务

- [防水服务总览](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/): 列出十一类服务及对应页面，区分局部维修和防水层更新。
- [淋浴漏水维修](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/leaking-shower-repairs/): 评估淋浴外溢、相邻地毯或墙体受潮，按查明的水源确定维修范围。
- [浴室防水与重新铺砖](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/bathroom-waterproofing/): 介绍湿区防水与重新铺砖，以及商定范围内的拆除、准备和收尾工作。
- [淋浴重新密封与填缝](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/shower-resealing-regrouting/): 适用情况下更换老化填缝及硅胶；表面接缝维修不能替代失效防水层。
- [阳台防水与漏水修复](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/balcony-waterproofing/): 评估瓷砖表面、门槛、排水口和墙面交界处，并考虑楼下房间的受潮情况。
- [厨房密封与重新密封](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/kitchen-sealing/): 介绍水槽边缘及防溅板接缝密封，区分这些接缝问题与给排水管道泄漏。
- [外部防水与进水维修](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/external-waterproofing/): 评估窗户、门和墙面交界处进水，并结合雨水、地面高差和排水情况判断。
- [洗衣房防水](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/laundry-waterproofing/): 介绍洗衣房翻新或维修中的湿区地板及交界处防水，结合基层与计划饰面确定要求。
- [屋顶漏水评估与防水](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/roof-waterproofing/): 介绍防水层表面、穿透处和排水口的评估边界，检查范围取决于屋面结构和安全通道。
- [挡土墙防水](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/retaining-wall-waterproofing/): 评估墙面潮湿及邻接区域进水，说明土侧通道和排水条件对维修方式的限制。
- [瓷砖重新填缝](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/tile-regrouting/): 介绍磨损或损坏瓷砖接缝的重新填缝，包括浴室外地板，以及水泥基或环氧填缝材料选择。
- [商业防水](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/services/commercial-waterproofing/): 面向业主、物业经理及分层物业代表，说明防水评估、通道要求和需单独处理的工种任务。

## Company, service areas and contact / 公司、区域与联系

- [About MEL ONE](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/about/): Company background, waterproofing team, service capabilities and published company and insurance details.
- [关于 MEL ONE](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/about/): 介绍公司背景、防水团队、服务能力以及页面公开的公司与保险资料。
- [Service-area directory](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/service-areas/): District and locality navigation across the ACT; other suburbs can be supplied through the contact form.
- [服务区域目录](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/service-areas/): 按地区查找ACT防水服务页面，其他郊区可通过联系入口提供地址并咨询。
- [Contact and assessment requests](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/contact/): Provide the suburb, affected area and timing to arrange an assessment, repair plan and written quote.
- [联系与现场评估申请](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/contact/): 提供郊区、受影响区域和问题发生时间，以安排现场评估、维修计划及书面报价。

## Project photographs and practical guides / 施工照片与实用指南

- [Waterproofing project photographs](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/case-studies/): Membrane application and tiled wet-area photographs; the bathroom views are not presented as a same-job before-and-after record.
- [防水施工照片与案例](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/case-studies/): 查看防水层施工及瓷砖湿区照片；页面未将这些浴室照片表述为同一工程的前后对比。
- [Shower plumbing leaks and waterproofing failure](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/guides/shower-plumbing-or-waterproofing/): Wet carpet, damp walls and ceiling leaks: distinguishing plumbing, surface escape and concealed waterproofing problems.
- [淋浴管道泄漏与防水层问题指南](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/guides/shower-plumbing-or-waterproofing/): 结合地毯、墙面及天花板受潮场景，区分管道、表面水外流和隐蔽防水层问题。
- [Regrouting, resealing or membrane renewal](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/guides/regrouting-resealing-or-rewaterproofing/): Grout, silicone and membrane repair boundaries, including epoxy versus cement grout and renewal scope.
- [填缝、密封与防水层更新指南](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/guides/regrouting-resealing-or-rewaterproofing/): 比较填缝、硅胶密封与防水层更新的边界，说明环氧与水泥基填缝材料的差别。
- [Balcony leaks affecting a room below](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/guides/balcony-leaking-room-below/): Ceiling stains below a balcony, drainage and junction details before choosing local sealing or membrane renewal.
- [阳台漏水影响楼下房间指南](https://www.canberrawaterproof.com.au/zh/guides/balcony-leaking-room-below/): 从阳台下方水渍、排水及连接细节出发，比较局部密封与防水层更新的适用范围。
